subject: FINAL Slot05: failure forensics + wallpaper-underlay classification contract
body: Final R&D handoff. START=FINAL main bfbf5d68fc84cab62cadcbc0b6bc5eefbc7ba5ea; no drift. Field classifier: supplied 3025-line Gen4 Alpha1 trace contains one app session, one AccessibilityService connection/epoch, one Shizuku connection and one shell session across 10 terminal close cycles, with no observed lifecycle reset. Therefore the captured failure class should not be called a proven Java/app/accessibility/Shizuku crash. Current source has no explicit Home/Launcher crash fallback. The tester-visible wallpaper return is best treated as a strong presentation/underlay-exposure hypothesis: seven cover visual teardown events have a Samsung FoldInteractive wallpaper-identity transition within +/-500 ms, but wallpaper metadata is not presentation proof. Proposal adds FailureEpisodeReceipt, richer ApplicationExitInfo ingestion, controller-epoch liveness truth, and presentation-gap receipts; no production writes. Synthetic classifier 5/5 PASS. Physical Fold7 validation remains required.
